text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text: If we work together, we can prevail!
text_block_list.orig_text: 全員で連携すれば必ず勝てる！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
決着をつけるよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna pay for tricking everyone!
I won't forget what you did!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくもみんなを騙したッスね！
絶対に許さないッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Dear me. All this cameraderie is hardly my style...
But I'll lend you a hand this once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
こういうのは性に合わないんだが。
今回だけは協力してやろう！
